description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. 
 
 The Crown Is Yours 
 
 About the role 
 Join Data Engineering at DraftKings and help turn business data into reliable datasets that people can use. You will work with experienced engineers and business partners to understand questions, write SQL, improve existing data models and pipelines, and check that the results are correct.You'll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge tools and see your work drive innovation across DraftKings. 

 What you will do 
 Write and update SQL queries to answer business questions and transform data. 
 Make scoped changes to existing data models and extract, transform and load (ETL) pipelines, with support from experienced engineers. 
 Validate your work using expected results, sample records and checks for missing, duplicated or inconsistent data. 
 Investigate unexpected results, explain what you found and ask for help when the cause or impact is unclear. 
 Work with engineers and business partners to clarify requirements and understand how the data will be used. 
 Participate in code reviews, respond to feedback and document changes so others can understand and maintain them. 
 Learn to use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly, checking their outputs and protecting sensitive information. 
 
 What you will bring 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or any suitable combination of education, experience, and training. 
 Foundational SQL skills, including filtering, joins and aggregations, and the ability to explain what a query does. 
 An understanding of tables, keys and basic data relationships, with experience reading and modifying an existing query, model or data transformation. 
 A practical approach to checking results and working through a problem step by step. 
 Clear communication, willingness to ask questions and examples of learning from feedback. 
 Interest in understanding the business and the people who use your work. 
 Exposure to Python, Git, cloud data warehouses, or tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or AIrflow 

 
 Join Our Team 
 
 We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. 
 
The US base salary range for this full-time position is 84,000.00 USD - 105,000.00 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits as applicable. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
